ayarlar.notificationsHint: If this is off, you won't get notified when a follow-up is due.
ayarlar.screenshotHint: If enabled, whenever you take a screenshot (with the app open, or when you return here from another app) we'll ask with a notification — "want me to add this to your follow-ups?". Only if you say "yes" does that image open for you to review; no image is ever scanned automatically or sent to AI without your confirmation.
ayarlar.permissionRequiredMessage: This feature needs notification and gallery permissions.
ayarlar.exportHint: You can save all your people, follow-ups and notes as a readable JSON file via your phone's share sheet (AirDrop, Files, email, etc.).
ayarlar.exportError: Couldn't export your data. Please try again.
ayarlar.deleteAllButton: Delete My Account and All Data
ayarlar.deleteAllHint: Permanently deletes all people and follow-up data on this device. This cannot be undone.
ayarlar.deleteAllAlertTitle: Delete my account and all data
ayarlar.deleteAllAlertMessage: All people, follow-ups and reminders will be permanently deleted from this device. This action CANNOT BE UNDONE. We recommend exporting your data before continuing.
ayarlar.deleteAllError: Something went wrong while deleting your data.
ayarlar.appLockHint: If enabled, the app will ask for Face ID/Touch ID or your device passcode every time it comes back to the foreground (reopening it, or returning from another app) — to keep your people and follow-up data private.
ayarlar.appLockFailedMessage: Authentication couldn't be completed. Make sure Face ID/Touch ID/a passcode is set up on your device and try again?
ayarlar.aboutText: Synvia AI exists so you never forget the promises you've made to others, or the things you're waiting on from them — not a to-do list, a reminder partner.
ayarlar.privacyText: All your data (follow-ups, people, notes) is stored locally on this device only — it's never synced to a server. When you extract from text/voice/image or ask the AI Assistant a question, only the content you send at that moment is sent to the AI provider; nothing else is ever shared in the background.
ayarlar.aiProvidersText: Anthropic (Claude) is used for text/image analysis and the AI Assistant; OpenAI (Whisper) is used to transcribe voice notes.
